name: Teddy
source:
We should all be so lucky to have a friend like Teddy. And Teddy would probably be a friend to us all! My only problem there is that he's just so darned relaxing. I want to hear all of the wonderful stories he's got, but by just a minute or two into them, with his soothing voice and that soft shoulder... I'm asleep. Guess I'll just have to keep tryin'.
Likes: Dispensing Wisdom, Dispensing Stories
Dislikes: Criticism

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
